label: Airbrush Space Art
mood: retro science-fiction airbrush — soft sprayed gradients, fine grain and glowing rims, as on 1970s paperback covers: a ringed planet in a star field, moons rising over alien dunes, or an orrery of planets on fine orbit lines; clouds and glows thin out behind the copy. Good for science and tech events, film and music nights, launches, sci-fi and gaming.

motif.note: planet | moons | orbits — what the picture shows

ring.note: planet: ringed planet; the ring is turned and sized so it clears the copy (false = plain planet, a little larger). orbits: a ring round the largest planet

moon.note: planet: a small crescent moon near the planet

nebula.note: nebula density: 0 = stars only … 1.5 = heavy clouds

stars.note: star density and number of bright stars

bands.note: cloud bands on the planets: 0.5 = broad … 2 = many fine bands

size.note: size multiplier of the hero (planet, big moon, or the whole orrery)

flare.note: soft round glow of the bright stars and of the sunlit limb, 0 = none (there are no spikes or streaks)

planets.note: orbits: number of planets / orbit lines (3–6)

planet.note: a large ringed planet with a sunlit limb, a small moon, stars and nebula

moons.note: two or three moons rising over soft alien dunes, a warm glow along the horizon

orbits.note: a small sun with planets on fine elliptical orbit lines, like an orrery
